[TPS_SYST_03073] Derivation of NmPnFilterMaskByte Status: DRAFT ⌈The CommunicationConnector.pncFilterArrayMask is configured per CommunicationConnector. This data mask is calculated over the whole payload of the NmPdu ignoring the leading bytes which do not contain pncVector information. The number of leading bytes which shall be ignored is equivalent to the value of System. pncVectorOffset.⌋ Example: For pncFilterArrayMask = 2 63 and pncVectorOffset = 2, pncIdentifier with number 63 in a NmPdu will be masked (see Figure 5.42). emplate
